subjects.description: A red and white striped railroad crossing gate arm lowered horizontally across the ego vehicle's lane, mounted on a black metal post with a pair of round red warning lights at the top.

subjects.relationship: The primary obstacle in the ego vehicle's path that it fails to detect and stop for.
subjects.location: Center-to-left foreground, spanning across the near lane ahead.
subjects.orientation: Gate arm oriented roughly perpendicular to the road, angled slightly toward the camera as the vehicle approaches.
subjects.pose: Fully lowered, horizontal across the lane blocking passage.
subjects.action: Standing lowered with warning lights flashing red.
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger and closer as the ego vehicle continues driving toward it; red lights continue flashing on and off.

subjects.appearance_details: Weathered locomotive at the head pulling rust-brown, grey, and faded blue freight cars with graffiti tags and reporting marks; headlight glowing faintly against the overcast light.
subjects.relationship: Cross-traffic hazard moving perpendicular to the ego vehicle's path, reinforcing the danger of the ignored crossing.
subjects.location: Right midground, moving from right to center along the tracks.
subjects.orientation: Traveling leftward across the frame, side profile facing the camera.

subjects.relationship: The camera platform; the vehicle whose failure to detect the gate drives the scene.
subjects.location: Camera position, hood at bottom foreground.
subjects.orientation: Facing forward down the road toward the crossing.
subjects.action: Traveling at steady cruising speed straight toward the lowered gate without slowing.

background_setting: A rural two-lane asphalt road running straight toward a level railroad crossing beneath a flat, overcast grey sky. The road has faded yellow center lines and gravel shoulders bordered by dry grass, scattered utility poles, and bare shrubs. Railroad tracks cross the road perpendicularly, with crossing gates, crossbuck signs, and signal masts flanking both sides. On the right, tracks curve off into the distance where a freight train approaches. Distant tree lines and low hills fade into a hazy horizon under the diffuse daylight.
